messages.author: 4d367efe02bee69e
messages.subject: Time Series models paper
parts:
Hi,

I would like to report that mine and Qinqin Zhang's paper on extending and generalizing Exponential Smoothing models using Stan is available in Proceedings of 35th International Symposium on Forecasting, at

http://forecasters.org/wp-content/uploads/gravity_forms/7-621289a708af3e7af65a7cd487aee6eb/2015/07/Smyl_Slawek_ISF2015.pdf


Big thanks for all Stan's contributors!


Regards,

Slawek Smyl

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Time Series models paper
parts:
Thanks for letting us know. I just added it to the citation list
on our web page:

http://mc-stan.org/citations/

under the heading "Papers using Stan".

We're happy to add to citations if people let us know. Given the
rather non-discriminative name of the project, it's non-trivial
to find them ourselves.

- Bob
